answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the copper deposit is held in the delta escrow, the dawn audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 77 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. A farm of 26 pays that 92 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
